name: switchboard
description: A board beside the chat for people who run many Claude Code sessions at once: which ones are waiting on you, what each needs, coordinators grouped with the sessions they started, and one click to jump there.

language.title: Language
language.description: The board's language, and the language its short lines are written in. auto follows your system locale.

summaries.title: Short lines by a small model
summaries.description: Have Claude Haiku turn each session's latest state into a few short lines (what it is doing, what it needs from you). Uses your own Claude usage; each session's content is written up once and shared by all your sessions. Off: the board shows the records' own words, cut short, and terminal sessions show up as waiting only when they ask you a question.

openPane.title: Open the board
openPane.description: auto opens the board beside the chat when a session starts (when the window is wide enough); command opens it only from the Board button above the prompt or /switchboard.

footerCommand.title: Footer button: command
footerCommand.description: A slash command (without the slash) for a button at the bottom of the board, such as a cleanup command of your own. Empty: no button.

footerLabel.title: Footer button: label
footerLabel.description: The footer button's label. Empty: the command's name.
